response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS mean_avg_rebate, AVG(p.avg_net_rate) AS mean_avg_net_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_rate - o.avg_net_rate) AS mean_excess_net_rate FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_net_rate > o.avg_net_rate

assumptions.assumption: The overall average net fee rate is calculated across fee records, with missing net rates skipped.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average gives each order group, including the group with no order, equal weight.
